item.title: FPGAs : Working with DPU Part 1
item.author: Jack Bonnell
item.description: This week I have been working on a DPU project for the Ultra96-V2. I am currently running this project on the 2025.2 Xilinx toolchain. The initial work needed was to create a Xilinx Support Archive that I could use with either the PetaLinux flow or the Vitis flow, allowing me to run localised AI models on the Ultra96-V2. Step 1: Creating the block design You can see from the image below that I have created a basic block design for the DPU.
